purpose: PS4 NixOS external USB boot candidate, preserving internal Orbis
omarchy_psx_adaptation: MIT USB ancestry/two-partition/FAT-label validation adapted to the NixOS Btrfs image; no Omarchy rootfs or desktop
firmware: Extracted locally from the booting console by loader, never bundled or fetched by Nix
hardware_scope: Source lineage has recorded Baikal B1 Slim evidence. This derivative needs physical qualification; no original-console support claim.
candidate_changes: fleet-network.config enables netfilter/nftables/iptables compatibility and TUN
distinct local version to prevent mixing reference modules
disable compiler plugins and debug information for a bounded reproducible rebuild
fixed Nix build timestamp/user/host; firmware remains external
external-root command line globally disables libata devices
v2 kernels enable BTRFS_FS_POSIX_ACL after an actual USB-root VM exposed journald ACL failures; new module-release identities prevent v1/v2 mixing
v3 kernels add BPF_SYSCALL, CGROUP_BPF, BPF_JIT and BPF_UNPRIV_DEFAULT_OFF for actual NixOS DefaultIPAccounting and stock unit IPAddressDeny policies; nftables remains independent

gpu.kernel: amdgpu CIK with GPUVM and compute queues; no KFD dependency
